items.text: Crew,
after a healthy amount of time in Permanent Beta we're pushing 1.3.0 to the default branch here on Steam. Thank you to all of you who tried the build!
Fixed an issue with "Two is megli che uan" not triggering. Now it correctly unlocks after purchasing a second broken fan after unlocking Gardening.
Improved savefiles to be more resilient to occasional corruption.
Fixed an issue where a Random Event could trigger while using the Sonar.
Fixed an issue where Hints could trigger on top of Actiivities and other sequences.

Fixed an issue where Aspirations that required obtaining marbles could exceed the maximum number of Marbles attainable.
Fixed an issue where the Skill Unlock modal could trigger over a dialogue or quest screen.
Fixed an issue with Raise Dust showing the "Smoked" icon for 3 segments.
Fixed an issue with "Told You So" not working on Round 01.
Fixed an issue with Energy Saver and It's Personal not working properly with the Boxer.
Fixed an issue with Stun stunning extra enemies.
Fixed an issue with the Screamers palette not showing properly in combat.
Fixed an issue with the Smoothie effect that grants an extra action in the first planning phase.
Fixed an issue with Tuning skills incorrectly providing extra slots.
Fixed an issue with some Monki chest parts not providing Healing Gel ammo.
Fixed an issue with Serene Gigantopithecus Chest not showing the proper landing segment for the Missile.
Fixed an issue where Jackrabbits had infinite ammo.
Fixed an issue where Jackrabbits would ignore evasion with some attacks.
Fixed an issue where Jackrabbits AI would sometimes place orders partially into the next turn.
[p align="start"]Please note that the "Finders Keepers" achievement is actually not bugged - just requires some patience to wait for 5 events to spawn around you.
We're continuing to investigate some issues reported more recently as well as potential UI/UX improvements that we might introduce at a later date.
Please let us know your thoughts here on the Steam forums or on Discord. We have a pretty nice community going on there so check it out!
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Thanks for all the support!
GP
Crew,

in the past couple of days we issued a couple of hotfixes for the most pressing issues we observed at launch. Today we're releasing version 1.2.2 that fixes the last known major issue as well as a few minor issues. Here's a complete changelog of everything we fixed this week.
Fixed a crash when moving the left analogue stick during some dialogues

Fixed a softlock/loop where if a pilot would get gravely wounded during the initial part of "The Mechanic" quest you'd get stuck in an infinite loop. This fix should be retroactive so existing savefiles should be fixed now. Please let us know if that's not the case.

Fixed an issue with Cool/Hot Headed portraits not matching their personality.

Fixed the palette of the Screamers if you had a custom paint yourself.
That should be all for now.
We're collecting your bug reports and investigating fixes. Feel free to join us on Discord to interact with other members of the community and with the development team.
Cheers,
GP

releases.displayName: Patriot Update is now LIVE! - New Mech, Quest Line & More!

items.text: Crew, we have a major update!
After a couple of weeks in open beta, the Patriot Update is now out for everybody!
This update introduces a new playable mech alongside the Resonant Accord quest line and more!

It all started with the Monki. It was the first design that internally really clicked. We made it into our starting mech and more or less the symbol of NGO. As our starting mech it needed to be sort of well rounded and offer a bit of everything. Most of all I think we tried to make it high in survivability.

Then we moved on to the Ocelot: a ranged-focused Mech with a giant revolver on its arm. This is where we started to play with the idea of highly specialized mechs. After the Ocelot it only made sense to go with a melee-focused model and that's how the Patriot was born.

Internally we always called it the "Boxer" and in it you can probably see many different inspirations - from Hajime no Ippo to SFIII's Dudley. Then came the Resonant Accord and we styled its personality and moveset accordingly.
The Patriot can be unlocked following a brand new quest line in Resonant Prime.
It's a melee-focused mech with some limited ranged options that is all about getting up close and personal with some interesting options to isolate targets and rain punches on them.
It sports a unique combo mechanic that sets it apart from the Monki and Ocelot.

[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/41418d4aae9c11eb522880af6e62a523e851c146.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/58e6a331e66df5e66ce5650e5755a50cd04ad540.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/98e5b931609de9f064e6eed80e52bf6cc18d528d.jpg"]
Alongside the Patriot you can find
80+ unique parts for the Patriot
Loads of Tuning items unique to the new mech
2 achievements related to Patriot's quest line
It's time to get properly introduced to the Resonant Accord - one of the many factions that inhabit the continent and the only one with a plan to defeat the machines! (or so they say).
The quest line begins after completing "The Road to Resonant Prime" from the Traders' Gyld and it will lead you to meet new interesting characters and ultimately unlock the Patriot.
Peace in the Continent!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/a2606f7d4e538bb6282d49c03dd9de58b1d32376.jpg"]
Parts comparison has been added to the game both in the Loadout screen and in stores.
Other minor improvements
Please note that most of the Quality of Life improvements are coming in the 1.0 update. Stay tuned for more news and devlogs in the coming weeks.

notes.title: Other Improvements and Fixes from the Permanent Beta

items.text: Fixed issues with Push To Corner, flamethrower damage and electrified status

Overall the Patriot has been buffed significantly since the start of the beta. We plan to continue to monitor its status as more players get their hands on it and possibly adjust it further before the 1.0 release.
Tuning now properly consumes the parts used in the process.
Fixed the missile explosion animation caused by Countermeasures.
Fixed an issue where the Ocelot was unable to complete the reload
Some fine tuning on enemies
Some performances and UI improvements.
Localization update.
Minor bug fixes.
As mentioned in our Roadmap we're going to conclude the early access with the deployment of the main quest.

This is as good a time as any to remind everybody again that the Main Quest will require a brand new savefile in order to be experienced so on 1.0 you will have to start over (don't worry we're adding a "Skip Tutorial" option).
We have been working on the Main Quest and the 1.0 update for a minute now and it appears it's gonna be bigger than our inital expectations.

We've received a lot of feedback and suggestions from folks on Discord in regards to the Patriot, the Ocelot and the game in general. We're doing our best to take everything into consideration and address everything we can while sticking to the roadmap and the plans we had for it.

We will start to share development blogs here on Steam as we lead into the 1.0 to explain what's coming and the reasoning behind some choices. We might not be able to fit every suggestion we got into the 1.0 release but rest assured, we do read everything and we appreciate every feedback we got here and on Discord. We're truly doing our best to deliver the best game we can.

items.text: Crew,
Patch 08 is now available and it is a Major update to the game! This update completely reworks the tutorial and the introduces two new enemies.

[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/f98754b764cc723b505acd565e1cae559a2b38dc.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/52766c1696d78c99b3e5b074cfae42c424c57300.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/63114bf7e0ec0608aa7cf9774dfd8461450d9b50.jpg"]
Rewrote all tutorial texts and added a new "highlight" behavior that points to parts of the UI to interact with. Overall the tutorial should feel more clear and more streamlined.
This means that are some short "on-rails" flows that are meant to guide you through the UI to discover the most important features.
Some more advanced mechanics or situational stuff is explained via Hints. These Hints can be dismissed on a per-hint basis.
The tutorial locks you into the first part of the Map until completion - just to be extra safe you don't wander off before completing it.
The tutorial now ends with a proper explanation of the Sonar and brings you to Motorhold, where most of the current questlines start.
Added a situational quest that triggers the first time you have a gravely wounded pilot.
Added a situational quest that triggers the first time you are down to 3 pilots.
Hints should appear also on existing games but the new tutorial, as you might imagine, requires a new savefile to be experienced.
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/9850c3e758538d13dd2ec46dbc0801926b7f1fc3.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/082c3e9e41beea0b0588c195d4ff89dd914cb2e0.jpg"]
Two new enemies join the fray! A feedback we got since the beginning of the Early Access is that we lacked some ranged enemies variety, especially in the mid to late game. We're addressing that.
We're adding a Sniper-type enemy called Stymphalian and a variant with a different arsenal.
We're adding a Tank/Hovercraft hybrid called the Pillager that has both ranged and melee variants.

We're continuing our efforts to make the game more readable and address player feedback. In particular we looked into addressing all the confusion that stems from the "Mech and Crew not Ready" message and brought improvements to the Mech Building screen too.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/0f1e1786282d0ad3b6e796efc9964e37c85b21a1.jpg"]
Revamped mech building screen to offer more information on the validity of the current build and the status of the mech and crew.
Now the pre-battle screen offers warnings for wounded pilots, damaged mech and more.
Minor fixes and improvements here and there.
Added new parts for Male characters.
Switching from Mouse & Keyboard to Controller and vice-versa should be smoother now.
More optimizations - this time on the CPU side.
Some fine tuning on enemies and Tracked status.
Minor bug fixes.
As mentioned in our Roadmap we're going to focus on introducing a third Mech and we will conclude the early access with the deployment of the main quest... and more!

items.text: This update completely reworks the tutorial and the introduces two new enemies.

There's a lot going on in NITRO GEN OMEGA. Resources to manage, stats to keep in check, mood to balance and marbles to earn. Despite being a turn based RPG, sometimes the amount of information feels overwhelming, especially during the first few hours. We designed a gradual introduction to the mechanics but we didn't fully hit the mark.
Until now.
The revamped tutorial will help new players understand the complex yet eyecatching mechanisms of NITRO GEN OMEGA in a way we think will please you.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/f98754b764cc723b505acd565e1cae559a2b38dc.jpg"]New floating dialogue boxes are now delivering information that were somewhat implied before, while a spotlight mechanism will guide your gaze in areas you should pay attention to.

releases.displayName: Vocations update is now is now LIVE - New Activities, Items, Traits & more!

items.text: Crew,
Patch 07 is now available and it is a Major update to the game! We’ve reworked all the ship activities, introduced four new activities, expanded character traits, and so much more.

The entire activity system on the ship wasn’t quite in line with what we wanted to achieve, so to add more depth and interesting choices to this part of the game, we’ve rebalanced and revised the entire activity system, as well as added four new activities.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/5a6ed26e30edd38f5004ec6877d20f93f40384dd.gif"]
New statistic for pilots: Fatigue. It increases at the end of each fight and only decreases by performing certain activities so diversify your tasks!
Activities for friends and rivals. Two unlockable activities to make sparks fly!
Tuning is here! It allows pilots to customize their mech, turning scrap and other pieces obtained from enemies into mech parts.
Smoothie is ready! Prepare a delicious smoothies to provide powerful instant effects and new skills that last for several fights to the pilot who dares to drink them!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/f7840b721221fd49c5ec9e972d3a202bd2b75e6e.gif"]
13 new traits are now availble and 7 existing ones got an overhaul.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/d20d79420cbb50debe722f8423b0cacae20b9125.jpg"]
Understanding what activity can be done and what pilots are up for it is now easier than ever! And in case someone is not available, the reason why it is now explicit.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/255f8dd5370e03ae7a110c7f02fc3cbef6e457bd.jpg"]
We have added several new items, skills, etc.
55 new parts craftable with tuning
8 new ingredients for cooking and smoothies
4 new items to unlock activities
4 new homesteading skills for tuning
1 new event
Fixed an issue where pilots would be severely injured due to mech destruction even if the mech was still in one piece at the end of a failed encounter.

Fixed an issue where former member of your crews could be recruited again in the exact same status. That could lead to funny scenarios where someone would leave due to low mood then join to leave again for the same cause.
Fixed some animations and their SFX.
Fixed an issue in some encounters where the wrong goal was displayed, leading to some confusion.
Added a few missing strings and fixed some more.
Various fixes to minor issues.

As mentioned in our Roadmap our next focus is to revisit the tutorial and add two more enemies. After that, we will introduce the third playable mech and we will conclude with the deployment of the main storyline... and much more!

items.text: A complete rework of all activities, new activities, items, traits, and a lot more!
Crew, Patch 07 is now available on the Beta branch! We’ve reworked all the ship activities, introduced four new activities, expanded character traits, and so much more.

The entire activity system on the ship wasn’t quite in line with what we wanted to achieve, so to add more depth and interesting choices to this part of the game, we’ve rebalanced and revised the entire activity system, as well as added four new activities.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/5a6ed26e30edd38f5004ec6877d20f93f40384dd.gif"]

We have introduced a new statistic for pilots: Fatigue. Pilot fatigue always increases at the end of each fight and only decreases by performing certain activities. Unlike mood, having a high fatigue will never cause pilots to abandon the crew, but bad things could happen if it is not managed…

Unique activities for friends and rivals. We have introduced two activities that can only be performed by pilots who are friends or rivals. These two activities are not initially available but must be unlocked. The items to unlock them are on sale in the General Stores of some cities.

Tuning is one of the new activities introduced with this update. It allows pilots to further customize their mech, turning scrap and other pieces obtained from enemies into a new type of mech parts. There are a lot of new parts, ranging from Common to Legendary, for the Monki and the Ocelot.

Smoothie is one of the new activities introduced with this update. A pilot can prepare a smoothie using some of the ingredients that can also be used for cooking. Smoothies provide powerful instant effects and new skills that last for several fights. Unlike cooking, this activity only affects the character who performs it, not the entire crew.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/f7840b721221fd49c5ec9e972d3a202bd2b75e6e.gif"]

To further differentiate the characters from each other, we have significantly expanded the trait system, adding 13 new traits and completely changing the functioning of the seven existing ones. Each pilot can have up to two traits.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/d20d79420cbb50debe722f8423b0cacae20b9125.jpg"]

An activity’s icon now shows directly whether the activity has already been done or not, and it is no longer necessary to open it to find out. Furthermore, when choosing the characters to perform an activity, it is indicated which ones cannot do it and the reason for this.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/255f8dd5370e03ae7a110c7f02fc3cbef6e457bd.jpg"]
We have added several new items, skills, etc.
55 new parts craftable with tuning
8 new ingredients for cooking and smoothies
4 new items to unlock activities
4 new homesteading skills for tuning
1 new event
We are continuing to optimize the game to improve performance. The effect should be especially visible on Steam Deck and older graphics cards.
Various fixes to minor issues.
You will find a Beta branch right here on Steam called “Permanent Beta.”
You can access the Beta branch by right clicking on NITRO GEN OMEGA > Properties > Betas and selecting it from the dropdown menu.
The Beta comes with an important warning: BACK UP YOUR SAVE FILES.
Loading an existing save file might make it incompatible with the regular version of the game. Handle with care.
Your save files are located in %localappdata%\\Overdrive\\Saved\\SaveGames

After the much-needed changes to the map and ship, the next critical part of the game we want to revisit is the tutorial and the game’s first-player experience in general. Also, there might be a bit too few things shooting at you in battle; we might add a few more.

items.text: Crew, we have a major update coming and we need your help to test it!

notes.title: The Lost Frequencies update is now LIVE in the permanent beta branch of Steam.

items.text: This update completely reworks the Sonar you get at the beginning of the game and makes it into an active mechanic.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/3862f0808132e5cae0dd4c51ca75da1891578329.gif"]

Previously the Sonar would "vibrate" when in proximity of randomly spawned events and encounters. It would do so passively by changing the amplitude of a wave that surrounded your ship, in a somewhat subtle way. This led to many players missing the Sonar mechanic entirely and the world feeling more empty than it was supposed to be.
That's why we reworked it.

Now, the Sonar will alert you when there's stuff that can be found around you. When the Sonar buzzes, you can enter Search mode. While in Search Mode, Signals will approach your Airship - you'll need to lock onto these signals by pressing LMB (or A on the Controller) at the right time. When you do so they'll be highlighted for you and you'll be able to explore them and find out what's down there.
Once again, this update stems from your feedback.
After the Character Creator, the second most common feedback was that the world felt a bit "empty" with not much to do while traveling or inbetween contracts.
This update is the first step in addressing that.
We tried to make the Sonar more meaningful by making it an active mechanic while also adding more interesting encounters and "sonar-exclusive" rewards you can find around the world.

notes.title: New missions, a ton of new rewards

items.text: Lost Frequencies comes with 8 different missions you can find using the Sonar, including new wave-based encounters, timed deliveries and more.
These new missions bring a ton of new potential rewards including 10 new Epic Videogames, 17 new Chroma Paints and Recipes!
That's right, Recipes are now a collectible item you can find around the world - no more guesswork or datamining!
The Sonar also brings its own upgrades that can be purchased in Shops around the world and that will make Search Mode more forgiving.
We're also introducing a new enemy variant: The Gunblade Goblin. It's got guns, it's got blades, it's got gunblades!
With this update we're also introducing a much needed revamp of the world UI.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/355c877a9c3585fffb9a0143370e5e1e87764b37.jpg"]

The new UI features a clear indication of the Mood of each pilot, their health status and aspirations. Plus, we're introducing a "Low Supplies" warning, a "Damaged Mech" warning, a counter for Activity Tokens and a Wages timer.
Overall we tried to give you all the important informations you need while traveling around the Wastelands, while also improving the readability and usability of the UI.
You will find a Beta branch right here on Steam called "Permanent Beta".
You can access the Beta branch by right clicking on NITRO GEN OMEGA > Properties > Betas and choosing it from the drop-down menu.
The Beta comes with an important warning: BACK UP YOUR SAVEFILES.
Loading an existing save file might make it incompatible with the regular version of the game. Handle with care.
Your savefiles are located in %localappdata%\\Overdrive\\Saved\\SaveGames

Also, starting with this version we're experimenting with a handy auto-backup feature for savefiles. Your savefiles should be automatically backed up the first time you launch the beta. We might experiment in the future with allowing you to restore backup directly from the game. In the meantime, be safe out there and do your own backup!

With this update we're also laying the foundation for more quests to come in the future - technically the first step is all the sonar missions we added. We did a lot of work under the hood to ensure forward compatibility of your savefiles but we might have missed an edge case somewhere.
Additionally we reworked some things under the hood of the battle system.
Load your savefiles and let us know if everything is in order. Are your quests all in progress?
Are you noticing any changes in the battles? Any orders not working?
Are you enjoying the Sonar? :)
More cool stuff to come soon. We've been sharing the latest on our development streams on Twitch.
Lock onto those signals!
GP
Crew,
our most requested feature is now live in the game. The Character Creator v1 is now LIVE!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/0912b30a08c77673d180b9f9e76bf7a3ad707c32.png"]
Last week we released the Character Creator in beta and your response has been truly heartwarming.
We're happy to see that our efforts are resonating with you and we hope you can see that we're truly doing our best in crafting NITRO GEN OMEGA.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/e4f053455d883cfd8cd09a58a7e7b7f68b2a388a.jpg"]As we explained when we first announced it, the game was not meant to have a Character Creator. Our vision was for you to get attached to a random cast of character as if you just turned on the TV on a new anime show.
But you kept asking for it, so who are we to say no?

The game was built with procedural generation in mind, not to mention supporting hand-crafted 2d-looking animations so there's all sorts of hidden connections and limitations we built in for Generated Characters that we turned off for Created Characters.
This means we gave you as much freedom as we technically could when it comes to creating your own characters but some limitations might still apply here and there.

[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/467f8386119303ccd4389eaccb83259dd3977789.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/da8ae16da1f2cd9609e9a271a60c2aa035f4ab52.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/36abf167ca60512c252e66975237fad805824808.jpg"]
You can now access the Character Creator directly from the main menu.
You can create and customize your characters, including their appearance, palette, name, last name, birthday, attitude, portrait pose and more!
On a new game you can replace any of the four starting characters with a created character.
Some new hair and clothing have been added too.
Full localization for the Character Creator. We preferred to roll it out now after the Beta and localize later. Should be coming soon.
We plan to add more combinations of hair and upper bodies using the ones we already have (i.e. mixing jackets and shirts that are potentially compatible but not available yet).
We're working on allowing created characters to appear in Fool's Inn around the world and become recruitable.

We're also exploring ways to let you share your creations with other players. Technically you can already do so as every Created Character is just a file you can share. You will find your creations alongside your savefiies.
Your savefiles are located in %localappdata%\\Overdrive\\Saved\\SaveGames - you will find your Custom Characters in the "Saved" folder. Every Character is contained in its own folder.

notes.title: FAQ: Does this mean Procedurally Generated Characters are gone?

items.text: Not at all! Procedural Characters live alongside your creations and when you start a new game you can replace any of the four starting characters with Created ones. The generator is still there and working. When v2 goes live you will be able to choose how created characters will appear around the world in Fool's Inns alongside generated ones.
Here's a non exhaustive list of things we're working on.
A new mech!
Two new enemies with variants.
New variants for existing enemies.
A Sonar rework.
New activities & more.
We share regular updates with our community on Discord and our weekly stream.

items.text: [p align="start"]
[p align="start"]We'd like to thank the lovely people on our Discord who gave us feedback on the Character Creator as we were developing it.
[p align="start"]We hope you will like this update. We gave it our best to give you what you asked within the limits allowed us by the existing foundations of the game.
[p align="start"]Thanks folks!
Crew,

Patch 03 is finally out and we're bringing you a couple of highly requested features: a World Map and the possibility of picking which Skill gets replaced when a pilot has reached their limit and they level up.
We're working on some juicy stuff, but in the meantime I hope you'll enjoy this patch!
What's new

notes.title: Added a full-fledged in-game map to the game. Here's how it works

items.text: You can open the map by pressing M on the keyboard or X/Square on your controller.
Outposts and Capitals are now by default not shown in the minimap and map.
When a Location is first visited it will appear on the minimap and map.
When a Quest or Aspiration asks you to go to a specific Location, the location will still be marked on your map even if not discovered.
The map also groups the Outposts by faction.
The map shows the most important stores inside each location.

notes.title: Added the possibility of picking which Skill to replace when you level up. Here's how it works

items.text: Revamped the "New Skill Unlocked" screen.
Now when you unlock a new Skill with a Fool that has already reached maximum capacity, you will be prompted to choose a skill to replace or you can also discard the new randomly selected skill.
Added new Character Palettes!
Added a new portrait pose for the "Guy with Glasses" personality.
Fixed "Thrill of the Hunt" skill.
Fixed the position of the Greenhouse in Phoenix Cross.
All percentage-based skills now apply their bonus to the full value and not just the base value.
Skills that increase "All Damage" now also increase "Special Damage".
Fixed some Cooking Recipes that were impossible to cook.
Removed Bullet ammunitions from Monki parts that provided the Flamethrower order.
Fixed the magazine "Yep. It's Camporella".
Fixed a wrong texture on some shoes.
Improvements and tweaks to some animations.
Other minor improvements and fixes.
With the introduciton of the Map we've moved the hotkeys around on PC. Now you go back to your Airship with H, you open the Management Screen with O and you open the map with M.
We introduced some new strings into the game which aren't translated, we're aware and we're looking to rectify this soon!
Special shoutouts to The Grand Mugwump for the makeshift map that has carried the community until now. You're the Real MVP.

items.text: Crew,

today we come to you with a smaller patch focusing on addressing several bugs discovered by our community. We have another patch coming (hopefully this week) with more quality of life features, including a map!

notes.title: Here's a complete list of fixes

items.text: Fixed Countermeasures not intercepting missiles.
Fixed Extinguish Fire not working.

Fixed an issue where Pilots would get an aspiration to complete contracts for Anchorage even though Anchorage has no Fixer. Pilots that had this aspiration will see it removed (with no consequences to mood).

Temporarely removed the "Power Grid Management" skill from the Skill Pools as we investigate an issue with it (pilots that already have it will keep it but just know that the bonus is applied in the mech building but is not taken into account when checking if the mech is ready for combat - i.e. the bonus isn't being applied correctly).
Fixed Gardening sometimes not providing any crops.
Fixed an issue where orders in the timeline would display targets even when not present (or show a target zone AND entity).
Fixed an issue where targets would not appear in the Resolution Phase timeline.
Fixed an exploit where it was possible to obtain infinite supplies from the Gas Station (you're all going to jail).

Temporarely removed the "Spin Left" and "Spin Right" orders from the Prometheans as we investigate issues with them. They were making the Monkinators unfairly powerful and this should put an end to that.
Fixed an issue where eyelashes color was showing up as lipstick color. This means that some of you might see characters lose their lipstick or see the lipstick change color.
Fixed an issue with the "Full Stash" achievement.
Fixed some inconsistencies in order priorities.

Increased the frequency of Random Map Events (we're currently investigating why some of you have the feeling that they're not spawining at all - it's probably a mix of frequency, location and feel of the radar).
Should you encounter any issue with this version, the previous version of the game is available in a beta branch called "previous". This will always be true from now on.
We hope you'll enjoy our efforts in quickly patching out the issues we find. Stay tuned for another upcoming patch focusing on quality of life and new smaller features.
Crew, we're listening!
We come to you with the very first patch for the Early Access of NITRO GEN OMEGA which should bring some really sought after features and fixes.

Thank you for the warm reception of our little big game NITRO GEN OMEGA! We are going through all feedback you left us our Discord server, in livestreams' chats, forums and in the in-game form you can access just before exiting.

notes.title: Here's a list of everything that is new

items.text: When creating a new game, you can now lock characters you like in the character generation screen!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/8943b5e21e005ee739388eda2401a0205c973f9f.png"]

When you start a new game you can now lock characters before rerolling their appearance in order to keep the ones you like the most. This feature works when you create a game. Pilots that are available in cities cannot be rerolled, but you can visit the city after a while or move to another one to find one that vibes more with your Crew.
Bug Fixes
This include fixes to the Breakdown theme in battle, Engineering Skills appearing on the Driver and more.
Balancing Fixes
Your pilots should be unlocking skills slightly faster now as well as other smaller changes here and there.
Localization Fixes
Added some missing translations on most languages.

notes.title: Should you encounter any issue with this version, the previous version of the game is available in a beta branch called "previous". This will always be true from now on.

items.text: That's it! We hope you'll enjoy these changes. We're listening to your feedback and taking notes and addressing the most pressing issues. So far we've been very happy with the response and we're very grateful for all your feedback!
